title: Two-way driveway where it serves more than 10 dwellings, parking is 15 m or more from the street, or the street is a distributor or arterial
text: Driveways designed for two way access to allow for vehicles to enter the street in forward gear where: the driveway serves more than 10 dwellings; the distance from an on-site car parking to the street is 15m or more OR the public street to which it connects is designated as a primary distributor, district distributor or integrated arterial road.
notes: The three triggers are read as alternatives (the printed list joins only the last two with OR). parking.driveway.two_way and parking.driveway.parking_to_street_m proposed. The street class is site.primary_street_class (the driveway is assumed to connect to the primary street; verify for secondary street access). 'Integrated arterial' read as integrator_arterial.

verified.note: p43 the three triggers are a dash list with OR printed only after the second; the first is joined by neither AND nor OR.
